title: Ridon: GenCorp P2.14M paid to VP Duterte faces closer scrutiny

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The P2.14 million allegedly paid by GenCorp Industries Inc. to Vice President Sara Z. Duterte will face further scrutiny, Rep. Terry Ridon, a House impeachment prosecutor, said in a statement on Monday. Ridon said it would have to be decided whether additional records could establish the legal basis of the monthly payments
